# Quick Review



* What’s most important about this unit is that nothing we do with language is detached from the rest of what’s going on around us – our bodies\, our societies\, and our pop worlds\!
* Back to the question from the beginning – what is language?
  * Natural language vs\. conlang
* What do you need to make your own language?
* Why do we do it?
* Who cares?

# Quick Review

Three basic modes of human communication

::: {.notes}

Ask them what some of the modes of animal communication are

:::


---


# Review from Week 14

::: {.notes}

See if they can explain any of these

:::


---




* In your groups\, list anything you can think of as a way that an animal communicates\, including what you think it means
  * Ex\. “My dog whimpers when she’s hungry\.”
* As a class\, come together to discuss these forms of communication
  * Each group will now select/be assigned one animal
* Now\, back in your groups – describe as many of the ways that this  _specific animal communicates_ \, and explain how these modes of communication do or do not align with what we said about human language
  * Each group will do research and explain to the class\, so have someone take notes\!
